messages:
PagerDuty: SEV2 - continuous-batching service cb-main reporting sustained p50 > 1.8s and 5xx rising above 2% for >3m. Condition: cb_queue_depth > 1000 for 3m.

Rina Patel: taking pager. brief triage — linking dashboards and traces.

Marco Silva: dashboard https://dashboards.redwood/cb-main, heatmap shows sudden jump in kv_cache eviction rate around t-4m.

Dawn Lee: customer reports: streaming stalls and occasional 502s. Ticket #3388. Not widespread yet but high-volume tenants affected.

Marco Silva: logs from edge node 12: 
```
2026-04-02T02:13:10Z WARN kv_cache: pressure=0.93 evicted=410 shard=12
2026-04-02T02:13:11Z INFO continuous_batch: microbatch=1 queue_delay_ms=920 inflight=1900
2026-04-02T02:13:12Z ERROR runtime: prefix_recompute_miss spike=high
```

Omar Rizvi: looks like continuous-batching microbatches are sticking at size=1 under jittered arrival. That causes many tiny KV writes and thrashes the cache. I suspect prefetch heuristics + recent autoscaler bump made concurrency cross a tipping point.

Rina Patel: immediate mitigations I propose: 1) short ingress soft-cap 2) set continuous-batch.min_microbatch=3 for critical pools 3) temporarily disable prefetch window expansion. Who can apply patches?

Marco Silva: I can patch pool cb-main-west. Command: 
```
redwoodctl pools update cb-main-west --set continuous_batch.min_microbatch=3 --note "hotfix: increase min microbatch to reduce kv churn"
```

ops-bot: Patch request received. Scheduling canary 10% nodes.

Dawn Lee: enabling ingress throttle to 1200rps for 8m to let rollout settle. 
```
redwoodctl ingress throttle cb-main --rps 1200 --duration 8m
```

Rina Patel: also toggle kv_cache.adaptive_prefetch=false on canary to test.

Marco Silva: canary metrics after 90s: p50 went 1.9s->0.8s on patched hosts, eviction count down by ~78%. 5xx down to 0.4% in canary window.

Rina Patel: good. rolling to remaining nodes in cb-main-west and then cb-main-eu. rollout plan: canary 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 15s intervals.

ops-bot: rollout started by Marco Silva at 2026-04-02T02:17:40Z. progress: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100%.

Dawn Lee: after full rollout: overall queue_depth back under 250, microbatch median=3, p50=0.86s, 5xx=0.15%. Customer ticket #3388 updated with mitigation note and suggested client-side retry guidance.

Marco Silva: follow-on config to avoid future cliffs: add autoscaler safety hinge so autoscaler cannot increase concurrency > X above baseline without a warmup window. Also put kv_cache.soft_cap at 0.9 with larger eviction_window_ms to avoid cascade evictions.

Omar Rizvi: recommendation: add runtime circuit that forces fixed microbatch when queue_delay_ms > 700ms for >30s, and also a telemetry alert for kv_cache.eviction_rate crossing 0.6.

Rina Patel: creating incident doc INC-2026-0402-cb-kv-thrash and assigning followups: SRE-4722 (autoscaler safety), SRE-4723 (prefetch tuning), SRE-4724 (ci regression test).

PagerDuty: ALERT cleared at 2026-04-02T02:23:25Z - condition recovered for cb-main.

Dawn Lee: drafting customer-facing note: "We observed a performance regression impacting continuous-batching under very high concurrency. Immediate mitigations have been applied; we are conducting a root cause analysis and will publish remediation steps within 48 hours."

Rina Patel: handing to oncall follow-up: Omar and Marco please own the RCA. I'll monitor for 30m then mark resolved. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
